records.text: There was a president who suggested the precursor to AIPAC should register under FARA, and he ended up getting shot in a moving vehicle in broad daylight
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: You know, there once was a president who started talking about that—suggesting that the precursor to AIPAC, which became AIPAC, should register under FARA—and he ended up getting shot in a moving vehicle in broad daylight with the whole world watching.

verification.notes: The Kennedy administration's Justice Department asked the American Zionist Council to register under FARA in November 1962, and President John F. Kennedy was assassinated while riding in an open motorcade in November 1963. Calling the AZC simply the precursor to AIPAC and attributing the registration request personally to the president compresses a more complex organizational and administrative history. No evidence supports a causal connection between the FARA dispute and Kennedy's assassination; the statement juxtaposes related-to-topic but independent facts.
